about: Sitting 8a (the Dormitory Garden's evening and night, and the rooftop redone in place) written early by hand on 11 Oct 2026 at the owner's word ('Can we go on with the next batch of images?'): the garden relit from its chosen picture (version A), which is NOT installed, laid into a scratch root with a scratch manifest; the rooftop from the game's own picture. The prompts are the tool's own with the hour sentences below.

The garden's night is painted two ways for the owner to choose between. 'People at home' follows the owner's ruling O42 (a place is lit where someone is): a few upstairs windows of the two dormitories glow, the Common Room's house is dark, the stone lamps by the pond glow. 'Every window dark' is the same without the lit windows, as the Courtyard's night was chosen (O40). Both forbid added benches, signs, lamps and lights. check_prompts refuses a count of movable things ('two stone lamps').

Judge without installing: tools/py_art.sh tools/install_redo.py --relight dorm_yard <evening|night> <a> <b> --dry --against chosen/dorm_yard_1920.png, and tools/py_art.sh tools/install_redo.py rooftop <a> <b> --dry; then by eye for anything added, and that the tower, the far pagoda and the hills are still there.

sentences.dorm_yard_evening: Change the time of day to early evening: a warm orange and pink sunset sky, and low golden sunlight with long soft shadows. Windows already in the picture catch the light or begin to glow warm; add no new light.
sentences.dorm_yard_night: Change the time of day to night: a deep blue night sky with stars and a faint moon, and cool blue moonlight on everything, with soft shadows; the pond reflects the night sky. A few of the upstairs windows of the dormitories on either side glow warm, because people are at home; every other window is dark, and the house in the middle is dark. The stone lamps by the pond give a small warm glow. Everything in the garden and beyond it is still there, as dark shapes against the sky. Add no bench, sign, lamp or light that is not in the picture now.
sentences.dorm_yard_night_dark: Change the time of day to night: a deep blue night sky with stars and a faint moon, and cool blue moonlight on everything, with soft shadows; the pond reflects the night sky. Every window of every building is dark. The stone lamps by the pond give a small warm glow. Everything in the garden and beyond it is still there, as dark shapes against the sky. Add no bench, sign, lamp or light that is not in the picture now.

renders_kept_in: ~/Desktop/JJK Game images/ui2/early/renders/ (the eight files as ComfyUI saved them on 11 Oct 2026)

read_11_oct.install_redo_dry: The garden's six relights all PASS on the points. The rooftop: A PASS (nothing moved; 4.3 times sharper than today's picture); B LOOK (24 parts of the picture drawn differently: its sky and the far country are painted afresh, though no point moved more than 3 px).

by_eye.dorm_yard_evening: both faithful: the tower, the far pagoda, the pond, the steps and the stepping stones all there; windows lit in all three houses and the stone lamps glowing. In A the Common Room's house glows strongly through its paper screens, which suits the room where evenings are spent; B is quieter under a redder sky.
by_eye.dorm_yard_night_people_at_home: both faithful and both as asked: a few upstairs windows of each dormitory lit, the Common Room dark, the stone lamps glowing, nothing added. A shows a crescent moon; B shows none, so it cannot disagree with the full moon at the edge of the chosen Courtyard night.
by_eye.dorm_yard_night_dark: both faithful, every window dark, the stone lamps glowing. A shows a crescent moon; B none.
by_eye.rooftop: A is today's rooftop in the new look: the same clouds, hills, roofs and pagoda, drawn clean. B keeps the veranda and the roofs but paints a different sky and a different far valley, and thins the post at the left edge.

read_11_oct.my_picks: Garden: evening A; night with people at home, version B (the owner's ruling O42: the dormitories have people in them after dark; the dark B is the faithful alternative). Rooftop: A. Put to the owner; nothing was chosen when this was written.
read_11_oct.lessons: Forbidding added benches, signs, lamps and lights held again: nothing was added to any of the six garden pictures. Two of the four nights drew a crescent moon and two none; the Courtyard's chosen night has a full one, so the moon is worth a sentence of its own in every outdoor night ('no moon is in view' or its phase).
